data.long_meaning: The name Belanger originated from the French language and is composed of two parts: bel, which means 'beautiful, handsome' and ange, which means 'angel'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to have strong and brave personalities. The name Belanger carries the meaning “Strong, Brave Man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belanger usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
